subject: SIG artifact sprint: consolidated checklist + SOC2/pen-test extracts
messages:
From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@medicohealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medicohealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up + required extracts for security review

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our security team ran a quick triage and asked for a consolidated SIG deliverable we can hand to procurement and InfoSec. They specifically asked for: a short SOC 2 extract (summary page / control coverage), a pen test executive summary (top findings and remediations), ISO statements or attestation, and the deck you used for security/architecture.

Can you confirm what you can deliver by next Tuesday (3/28)? Procurement will need the artifacts to start the contract review. Also please include a single-file SIG answers export if you have one (JSON or spreadsheet).

Example ask from InfoSec (copied): 
- SOC 2 Type II report summary (last 12 months)
- Penetration test executive summary (most recent)
- ISO/other attestations (if applicable)
- The security overview slide deck used in the demo

Appreciate a concise packet — procurement prefers PDFs and one link for everything.

Thanks,
Claire Zhang
Senior Security Program Manager
MedicoHealth

--
attachments: none
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@medicohealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up + required extracts for security review

Claire —

Thanks for the clear list. Confirming we can assemble the packet by 3/28. Plan: Rishi will pull the SOC 2 summary and pen-test exec summary; Laura will validate the SIG export and mapping; I’ll assemble the security deck and a short cover note (1 page) that maps artifacts to the SIG question groups.

Quick asks for MedicoHealth:
- Is a Redacted SOC 2 summary OK (we redact customer-specific exhibits)?
- Any format preference for the SIG export (CSV vs JSON)? We can provide both but will keep one link as you requested.

I’ll drop the first draft by COB 3/26 for internal review and final packet on 3/28.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

attachments: none
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up + required extracts for security review

Team —

Attached are the artifacts I extracted for the packet:
- redwood_SOC2-type2_summary_2027.pdf (one-page executive summary + table of covered Trust Services Criteria)
- redwood_pen_test_exec_summary_2027.pdf (high-level findings and remediation status; no sensitive exploit details)
- redwood_security_deck_v2.pptx (10 slides: architecture, auth model, data flow, controls)
- sig_responses_2028-03-27.json (SIG export, answers mapped to MedicoHealth scoping notes)

Notes:
- SOC2: This is a redacted executive summary — we remove customer-identifying exhibit content and full control evidence folders. Compliance team confirmed this is allowed for procurement review.
- Pen Test: Exec summary only — full report is restricted; we can provide a summary of remediation timelines and status.
- ISO: We do not currently hold ISO 27001 certificate; we included an internal attestation statement in the security deck and the SIG notes include the compensating controls. If MedicoHealth requires ISO cert, we can discuss alternatives (additional audit clause or contract language).

Action items for Ben: please add the one-page cover note mapping each artifact to the SIG sections and confirm link we’ll share with the customer.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

attachments: redwood_SOC2-type2_summary_2027.pdf, redwood_pen_test_exec_summary_2027.pdf, redwood_security_deck_v2.pptx, sig_responses_2028-03-27.json
From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@medicohealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medicohealth.com
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up + required extracts for security review

Ben / Rishi —

Thank you — received the packet and the SIG JSON export link worked. Procurement confirms the redacted SOC 2 summary and pen-test exec summary are sufficient for initial contract review. A couple of quick clarifying Qs from InfoSec: 

1) On the SOC 2 summary table you note encrypted backups — can you confirm whether backups are encrypted at rest with customer-specific KMS keys or platform-managed keys?
2) On the pen-test exec, there’s a line item about "credential exposure risk" that InfoSec would like a short note on mitigation timeline (we saw "remediated Q4-2027" — can you confirm whether verification/testing has completed?).

If you can reply with those two items by EOD Friday (3/31) we’ll keep procurement moving. Also procurement asked if you can upload the packet to the HubSpot company record (link below) — they prefer attachments there for audit traceability.

HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If either of those answers require an NDA or additional redaction, flag me and we’ll pause until agreeable.

Regards,
Claire Zhang
Senior Security Program Manager
MedicoHealth

--
attachments: none
body_summary: External request for SIG artifacts. Redwood sent redacted SOC 2 summary, pen-test exec summary, security deck, and SIG export. Customer asked two clarifying questions about backup key management and pen-test remediation verification; requested upload to HubSpot.
